# Indian Railway Stations

All 7000+ railway stations with code, zone, division, state, and coordinates

- API: https://chirag127.github.io/india-railway-stations/data.json
- OpenAPI: https://chirag127.github.io/india-railway-stations/openapi.json
- Schema: https://chirag127.github.io/india-railway-stations/data/schema.json
- License: CC-BY-4.0
- Source: IRCTC / RailYatri open data
- Status: india-railway-stations
